name: 视距丝(横基尺)测距计算器

map.由横基尺长度与夹角求距离: Distance from Subtense Bar Length and Angle
map.输入横基尺长度 c 与所对夹角 θ（度），求距离。: Enter subtense bar length c and the subtended angle θ (degrees) to obtain the distance.
map.📖 查看「由横基尺长度与夹角求距离 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Distance from Subtense Bar Length and Angle User Guide"
map.由定长横尺张角算距离 D=cot(θ/2)·b。: Compute distance D = cot(θ/2)·b from the subtended angle of a fixed bar.
map.横尺长 b=2m、张角 θ=2° → D=cot(1°)×2=57.29×2≈1: Bar length b=2 m, subtended angle θ=2° → D = cot(1°)×2 = 57.29×2 ≈ 114.6 m.
map.θ 小则 D 对 θ 极敏感，需精测角；θ 大（近距）更准，远距换视距/EDM。: Small θ makes D extremely sensitive to θ, so measure the angle precisely; large θ (close range) is more accurate, switch to stadia / EDM at long range.
map.D=b/2 / tan(θ/2)=b·cot(θ/2)，b 为已知横尺长、θ 为: D = b/2 / tan(θ/2) = b·cot(θ/2), b is the known bar length and θ the subtended angle.
map.EDM 普及后用得少，教学与无电场景仍用，原理清晰。: Less used since EDM became common, but still used in teaching and power-free scenarios for its clear principle.
map.横基尺视距（本页代码口径，全角公式）：水平距离 D=横基尺长 c÷tan(θ)，: Subtense-bar stadia (page code convention, full-angle formula): horizontal distance D=subtense bar length c÷tan(θ), where θ is the parallax angle (entered in degrees, converted to radians first), not the half-angle form b÷(2·tan(θ÷2)); also outputs the km conversion and the D÷c ratio. Validation: both fields are required by input guards and must be valid numbers, otherwise a prompt is shown and the calculation stops. Criteria: no fixed grading; the smaller θ, the larger D, and the sensitivity ΔD÷Δθ=−c÷sin²θ rises sharply as θ decreases; the page shows this sensitivity alongside the result.
